system: You are Tarnwick's release assistant. Today is {today}. Answer from the platform team's standup memory in one or two sentences, starting with Yes, No or Unknown.
careful: Decisions in memory can carry a condition (unless, provided, only if, if, as long as). Say Yes only if memory records that the condition was met. If the condition's deadline has passed and memory has no record that it was met, say No. If its deadline is still ahead, say Unknown.

meetings.name: Platform standup 8 Sep
lines: pm
We ship the v4.2 billing release on October 20, provided the load test holds 2,000 requests per second by October 14.
sre
The Postgres 16 upgrade goes ahead on November 3, as long as the staging rehearsal passes by October 9.
em
We switch off the legacy auth service on November 1, provided the last three client apps migrate off it by October 12.
em
And the holiday code freeze starts on December 18.

meetings.name: Platform standup 15 Sep
lines: sec
We adopt Vendorly's feature-flag SDK only if security approves their SOC 2 report.
pm
Dark mode goes GA only if beta crash-free sessions stay above 99.5 percent.
em
CI moves to the new runners on October 27, as long as finance signs off the cost review by October 13.
pm
The internal hackathon is on December 4 if at least 15 engineers sign up by October 28.

meetings.name: Platform standup 22 Sep
lines: sec
I went through Vendorly's SOC 2 report and approved it on Friday, so the feature-flag SDK is cleared.

meetings.name: Platform standup 15 Oct
lines: sre
The v4.2 load test failed: at 2,000 requests per second the p99 latency hit 4 seconds.
pm
Beta crash-free sessions came in at 98.7 percent.
